title: Endocrine Regulation of Fetal Growth: High-Yield Quiz

questions.q: Which thyroid cells secrete T3 and T4, and which secrete calcitonin?

options.e: Wrong. Calcitonin comes from C cells.
Wrong. T3/T4 come from follicular cells.
Correct. Follicular cells make T3/T4, C cells make calcitonin.

questions.q: Where is thyroid hormone stored?

options.t: In follicular cell cytoplasm as free T4

options.e: Wrong. Lysosomes cleave the hormone for release.

options.t: In the colloid, bound to thyroglobulin
options.e: Correct. Stored extracellularly as thyroglobulin-bound hormone.

questions.q: Which transporter takes iodide into the follicular cell?

options.e: Wrong. Pendrin moves iodide into the colloid.
Wrong. It maintains the Na+ gradient.
Correct. It transports I- with 2 Na+.
Wrong. An enzyme, not a transporter.

questions.q: Which channel secretes iodide into the colloid?

options.e: Wrong. NIS takes iodide up from blood.
Wrong. It maintains the Na+ gradient.
Correct. Pendrin secretes iodide to the colloid.

questions.q: Which enzyme oxidizes iodide and iodinates thyroglobulin?

options.e: Correct. TPO oxidizes iodide and forms MIT and DIT.

questions.q: Which products conjugate to form T3 and T4?

options.e: Correct. Coupling of MIT and DIT gives T3/T4.

questions.q: Where are T3 and T4 cleaved from thyroglobulin?

options.e: Wrong. This is the storage site.
Correct. Colloid is endocytosed and cleaved there.

questions.q: Which enzyme converts T4 to T3?

options.e: Correct. It activates T4 in tissues.

questions.q: In which tissues is O2 consumption NOT increased by thyroid hormone?

options.e: Correct. Exceptions to the calorigenic effect.

questions.q: What is the net effect of thyroid hormone on protein metabolism?

options.e: Correct. Both synthesis and degradation increase.

questions.q: Which cardiovascular receptors does thyroid hormone up-regulate?

options.e: Correct. Increases heart rate and output.

questions.q: Which hypothalamic hormone stimulates TSH and which inhibits it?
Which form of thyroid hormone takes part in negative feedback?

options.e: Correct. Bound hormone does not feed back.

questions.q: Excess iodide inhibits thyroid hormone secretion. What is this effect called?
Which agents inhibit Na+-I- cotransport?
Propylthiouracil inhibits which enzyme?

options.e: Wrong. Not the main target here.

questions.q: A patient has Graves disease. What are her antibodies and TSH?

options.t: Antibodies against the TSH receptor; TSH decreased
options.e: Correct. Feedback inhibition by high T3/T4.

options.t: Antibodies against the TSH receptor; TSH increased
options.e: Wrong. TSH is low from feedback.

questions.q: What is TSH in primary hypothyroidism?

options.e: Wrong. This occurs with hypothalamic or pituitary defects.

questions.q: Which hormone is the sole source of thyroid hormone for the fetus in early pregnancy?

options.e: Correct. The fetal thyroid works only from mid to late pregnancy.
Wrong. The placenta does not produce it.

questions.q: Which hormone maintains the corpus luteum for progesterone production?

options.e: Wrong. Acts on metabolism and mammary growth.
